    4                                                // Description : 32KB 8-way set-associative instruction cache

    6                                                //               Single-port BRAM per way, 1-cycle BRAM latency (pipelined read)
    7                                                //
    8                                                // IMPORTANT SINGLE-PORT RULE (to avoid read/write address clobbering):

    86                                                   output logic [1:0]                 l2_vmeta_mesi,
    87                                                   output logic                       l2_vmeta_dirty,
    88                                               
    89                                                   // ---------------------------
    90                                                   // Victim line read interface (by set+way)
    91                                                   // ---------------------------
    92                                                   input  logic                       l2_vline_rd_en,
    93                                                   input  logic [SET_BITS_LEN-1:0]    l2_vline_rd_set,
    94                                                   input  logic [2:0]                 l2_vline_rd_way,
    95                                                   output logic                       l2_vline_rd_valid,
    96                                                   output logic [511:0]               l2_vline_rd_data,
    97                                                   output logic [TAG_BITS_LEN-1:0]    l2_vline_rd_tag,
    98                                                   output logic                       l2_vline_rd_entry_valid,
    99                                                   output logic [1:0]                 l2_vline_rd_mesi,
    100                                                  output logic                       l2_vline_rd_dirty,
    101                                              
    102                                                  // ---------------------------
    103                                                  // Lookup outputs
    104                                                  // ---------------------------
    105                                                  output logic [CORE_DATA_WIDTH-1:0] l2_rdata,
    106                                                  output logic                       l2_hit,
    107                                                  output logic                       l2_rvalid,
    108                                                  output logic [2:0]                 l2_hit_way,
    109                                                  output logic [1:0]                 l2_mesi_state,
    110                                                  output logic                       l2_dirty,
    111                                                  output logic                       l2_lookup_valid
    112                                              );
    113                                              
    114                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    115                                                  // Local parameters
    116                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    117                                                  localparam int LINE_BYTES = 1 << BYTE_OFFSET_BITS_LEN; // 64
    118                                                  localparam int LINE_BITS  = BYTE_SIZE * LINE_BYTES;    // 512
    119                                                  localparam int NUM_SETS   = 1 << SET_BITS_LEN;         // 2048
    120                                              
    121                                                  localparam logic [1:0] MESI_I = 2'b00;
    122                                                  localparam logic [1:0] MESI_S = 2'b01;
    123                                                  localparam logic [1:0] MESI_E = 2'b10;
    124                                                  localparam logic [1:0] MESI_M = 2'b11;
    125                                              
    126                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    127                                                  // Address fields using macros
    128                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    129             1                          4         wire [TAG_BITS_LEN-1:0]         lookup_tag    = l2_lookup_addr[`TAG_BITS];
    130             1                          4         wire [SET_BITS_LEN-1:0]         lookup_set    = l2_lookup_addr[`SET_BITS];
    131             1                          4         wire [BYTE_OFFSET_BITS_LEN-1:0] lookup_offset = l2_lookup_addr[`BYTE_OFFSET_BITS];
    132             1                          2         wire [2:0]                      lookup_word   = lookup_offset[5:3]; // 864b words/line
    133                                              
    134             1                          4         wire [TAG_BITS_LEN-1:0] line_rd_tag = l2_line_rd_addr[`TAG_BITS];
    135             1                          4         wire [SET_BITS_LEN-1:0] line_rd_set = l2_line_rd_addr[`SET_BITS];
    136                                              
    137                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    138                                                  // Pipeline registers (1-cycle read latency)
    139                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    140                                                  logic [TAG_BITS_LEN-1:0] tag_r;
    141                                                  logic [SET_BITS_LEN-1:0] set_index_r;
    142                                                  logic [2:0]              word_index_r;
    143                                                  logic                    op_en_r;
    144                                                  logic                    op_is_line_r;
    145                                                  logic                    op_is_vline_r;
    146                                                  logic                    op_was_store_r;
    147                                                  logic                    l2_store_en_r;
    148                                                  logic                    vline_fire_r;
    149                                                  logic [2:0]              vline_way_r;
    150                                                  logic [SET_BITS_LEN-1:0] vline_set_r;
    151                                              
    152                                                  // Store context locking (same concept as your L1_Dcache)
    153                                                  logic                    last_hit_locked;
    154                                                  logic                    last_hit_valid;
    155                                                  logic [SET_BITS_LEN-1:0] last_hit_set;
    156                                                  logic [2:0]              last_hit_way;
    157                                                  logic [2:0]              last_hit_word;
    158                                              
    159                                                  // Stall lookups that are stores while a prior store hit is waiting to commit
    160             1                          2         assign l2_lookup_stall = last_hit_locked & l2_lookup_is_store;
    161                                              
    162                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    163                                                  // Operation firing logic (single-port: read conflicts with fill/store/vline)
    164                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    165             1                         14         wire lookup_fire = 
    166                                                      l2_lookup_en & 
    167                                                      ~l2_fill_en & ~l2_store_en & ~l2_vline_rd_en &
    168                                                      ~(last_hit_locked & l2_lookup_is_store);
    169                                              
    170             1                         12         wire line_rd_fire  = l2_line_rd_en & ~l2_fill_en & ~l2_store_en & ~l2_vline_rd_en;
    171             1                          6         wire vline_rd_fire = l2_vline_rd_en & ~l2_fill_en & ~l2_store_en;
    172             1                         18         wire read_op_fire  = lookup_fire | line_rd_fire | vline_rd_fire;
    173                                              
    174                                                  // Register vline valid for output timing
    175             1                          3         always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    176                                                      if (!rst_n) begin
    177             1                          2                 vline_fire_r  <= 1'b0;
    178             1                          2                 l2_store_en_r <= 1'b0;
    179                                                      end else begin
    180             1                          1                 vline_fire_r  <= vline_rd_fire;
    181             1                          1                 l2_store_en_r <= l2_store_en;
    182                                                      end
    183                                                  end
    184                                              
    185                                                  // Pipeline stage capture
    186             1                         19         always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    187                                                      if (!rst_n) begin
    188             1                          2                 tag_r          <= '0;
    189             1                          2                 set_index_r    <= '0;
    190             1                          2                 word_index_r   <= '0;
    191             1                          2                 op_en_r        <= 1'b0;
    192             1                          2                 op_is_line_r   <= 1'b0;
    193             1                          2                 op_is_vline_r  <= 1'b0;
    194             1                          2                 op_was_store_r <= 1'b0;
    195             1                          2                 vline_way_r    <= '0;
    196             1                          2                 vline_set_r    <= '0;
    197                                                      end else begin
    198                                                          if (read_op_fire) begin
    199                                                              if (vline_rd_fire) begin
    200             1                    ***0***                         tag_r           <= '0;
    201             1                    ***0***                         set_index_r     <= l2_vline_rd_set;
    202             1                    ***0***                         word_index_r    <= '0;
    203             1                    ***0***                         op_en_r         <= 1'b1;
    204             1                    ***0***                         op_is_line_r    <= 1'b0;
    205             1                    ***0***                         op_is_vline_r   <= 1'b1;
    206             1                    ***0***                         op_was_store_r  <= 1'b0;
    207             1                    ***0***                         vline_way_r     <= l2_vline_rd_way;
    208             1                    ***0***                         vline_set_r     <= l2_vline_rd_set;
    209                                                              end else if (line_rd_fire) begin
    210             1                          4                         tag_r           <= line_rd_tag;
    211             1                          4                         set_index_r     <= line_rd_set;
    212             1                          4                         word_index_r    <= '0;
    213             1                          4                         op_en_r         <= 1'b1;
    214             1                          4                         op_is_line_r    <= 1'b1;
    215             1                          4                         op_is_vline_r   <= 1'b0;
    216             1                          4                         op_was_store_r  <= 1'b0;
    217             1                          4                         vline_way_r     <= '0;
    218             1                          4                         vline_set_r     <= '0;
    219                                                              end else begin
    220             1                          4                         tag_r           <= lookup_tag;
    221             1                          4                         set_index_r     <= lookup_set;
    222             1                          4                         word_index_r    <= lookup_word;
    223             1                          4                         op_en_r         <= 1'b1;
    224             1                          4                         op_is_line_r    <= 1'b0;
    225             1                          4                         op_is_vline_r   <= 1'b0;
    226             1                          4                         op_was_store_r  <= l2_lookup_is_store;
    227             1                          4                         vline_way_r     <= '0;
    228             1                          4                         vline_set_r     <= '0;
    229                                                              end
    230                                                          end else begin
    231             1                          9                     op_en_r        <= 1'b0;
    232             1                          9                     op_is_line_r   <= 1'b0;
    233             1                          9                     op_is_vline_r  <= 1'b0;
    234             1                          9                     op_was_store_r <= 1'b0;
    235                                                          end
    236                                                      end
    237                                                  end
    238                                              
    239                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    240                                                  // TAG + VALID + MESI + DIRTY ARRAYS (NO RESET to speed synthesis)
    241                                                  // Valid bits default to 0, which means all entries are invalid on power-up
    242                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    243                                                  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) logic [TAG_BITS_LEN-1:0] tag_array   [0:NUM_SETS-1][0:NO_OF_WAYS-1];
    244                                                  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) logic                    valid_array [0:NUM_SETS-1][0:NO_OF_WAYS-1];
    245                                                  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) logic [1:0]              mesi_array  [0:NUM_SETS-1][0:NO_OF_WAYS-1];
    246                                                  (* ram_style = "distributed" *) logic                    dirty_array [0:NUM_SETS-1][0:NO_OF_WAYS-1];
    247                                              
    248                                              
    249                                              initial begin
    250             1                          1         for (int s = 0; s < NUM_SETS; s++) begin
    250             2                       2048     
    251             1                       2048             for (int w = 0; w < NO_OF_WAYS; w++) begin
    251             2                      16384     
    252             1                      16384                 valid_array[s][w] = 1'b0;      // All invalid on startup
    253             1                      16384                 dirty_array[s][w] = 1'b0;      // All clean
    254             1                      16384                 mesi_array[s][w]  = MESI_I;    // All Invalid
    255             1                      16384                 tag_array[s][w]   = '0;        // Don't care, but clear anyway
    256                                                      end
    257                                                  end
    258                                              end
    259                                                  // BRAM outputs (one per way)
    260                                                  logic [LINE_BITS-1:0] way_data [0:NO_OF_WAYS-1];
    261                                              
    262                                                  // BRAM control signals
    263                                                  logic [SET_BITS_LEN-1:0]  bram_addr;
    264                                                  logic                     bram_en  [0:NO_OF_WAYS-1];
    265                                                  logic [BRAM_WE_WIDTH-1:0] bram_wea [0:NO_OF_WAYS-1];
    266                                                  logic [LINE_BITS-1:0]     bram_din;
    267                                              
    268                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    269                                                  // Victim Metadata Peek (1-cycle latency, registered)
    270                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    271                                                  logic                    vmeta_en_r;
    272                                                  logic [SET_BITS_LEN-1:0] vmeta_set_r;
    273                                                  logic [2:0]              vmeta_way_r;
    274                                              
    275             1                          7         always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    276                                                      if (!rst_n) begin
    277             1                          2                 vmeta_en_r  <= 1'b0;
    278             1                          2                 vmeta_set_r <= '0;
    279             1                          2                 vmeta_way_r <= '0;
    280                                                      end else begin
    281             1                          5                 vmeta_en_r  <= l2_vmeta_en;
    282             1                          5                 vmeta_set_r <= l2_vmeta_set;
    283             1                          5                 vmeta_way_r <= l2_vmeta_way;
    284                                                      end
    285                                                  end
    286                                              
    287             1                          9         always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    288                                                      if (!rst_n) begin
    289             1                          2                 l2_vmeta_valid      <= 1'b0;
    290             1                          2                 l2_vmeta_tag        <= '0;
    291             1                          2                 l2_vmeta_line_valid <= 1'b0;
    292             1                          2                 l2_vmeta_mesi       <= MESI_I;
    293             1                          2                 l2_vmeta_dirty      <= 1'b0;
    294                                                      end else begin
    295             1                          7                 l2_vmeta_valid <= vmeta_en_r;
    296                                                          if (vmeta_en_r) begin
    297             1                          2                     l2_vmeta_tag        <= tag_array[vmeta_set_r][vmeta_way_r];
    298             1                          2                     l2_vmeta_line_valid <= valid_array[vmeta_set_r][vmeta_way_r];
    299             1                          2                     l2_vmeta_mesi       <= mesi_array[vmeta_set_r][vmeta_way_r];
    300             1                          2                     l2_vmeta_dirty      <= dirty_array[vmeta_set_r][vmeta_way_r];
    301                                                          end
    302                                                      end
    303                                                  end
    304                                              
    305                                                  // Victim line metadata (combinational from arrays, aligned with vline pipe)
    306             1                          3         assign l2_vline_rd_tag         = (op_is_vline_r) ? tag_array[set_index_r][vline_way_r]   : '0;
    307             1                          4         assign l2_vline_rd_entry_valid = (op_is_vline_r) ? valid_array[set_index_r][vline_way_r] : 1'b0;
    308             1                          4         assign l2_vline_rd_mesi        = (op_is_vline_r) ? mesi_array[set_index_r][vline_way_r]  : MESI_I;
    309             1                          2         assign l2_vline_rd_dirty       = (op_is_vline_r) ? dirty_array[set_index_r][vline_way_r] : 1'b0;
    310                                              
    311                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    312                                                  // Store context locking 
    313                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    314             1                         19         always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    315                                                      if (!rst_n) begin
    316             1                          2                 last_hit_valid  <= 1'b0;
    317             1                          2                 last_hit_locked <= 1'b0;
    318             1                          2                 last_hit_set    <= '0;
    319             1                          2                 last_hit_way    <= '0;
    320             1                          2                 last_hit_word   <= '0;
    321                                                      end else begin
    322                                                          // UNLOCK: when store actually fires
    323                                                          if (l2_store_en_r && last_hit_valid) begin
    324             1                    ***0***                     last_hit_locked <= 1'b0;
    325             1                    ***0***                     last_hit_valid  <= 1'b0;
    326                                                          end
    327                                                          // LOCK: store-hit lookup
    328                                                          else if (op_en_r && l2_hit && !op_is_line_r && !op_is_vline_r &&
    329                                                                   op_was_store_r && !last_hit_locked) begin
    330             1                    ***0***                     last_hit_valid  <= 1'b1;
    331             1                    ***0***                     last_hit_set    <= set_index_r;
    332             1                    ***0***                     last_hit_way    <= l2_hit_way;
    333             1                    ***0***                     last_hit_word   <= word_index_r;
    334             1                    ***0***                     last_hit_locked <= 1'b1;
    335                                                          end
    336                                                      end
    337                                                  end
    338                                              
    339                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    340                                                  // Store write mask / data placement (64-bit subline into 512-bit line)
    341                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    342                                                  logic [BRAM_WE_WIDTH-1:0] store_we_mask;
    343                                                  logic [LINE_BITS-1:0]     store_din;
    344                                              
    345             1                          2         always_comb begin
    346                                                      int lane_base;  // Moved inside always_comb
    347             1                          2             store_we_mask = '0;
    348             1                          2             store_din     = '0;
    349                                              
    350                                                      if (l2_store_en && last_hit_valid) begin
    351             1                    ***0***                 lane_base = last_hit_word * 8; // byte lanes
    352             1                    ***0***                 store_din[(last_hit_word*CORE_DATA_WIDTH) +: CORE_DATA_WIDTH] = l2_store_wdata;
    353             1                    ***0***                 for (int b = 0; b < 8; b++) begin
    353             2                    ***0***     
    354             1                    ***0***                     store_we_mask[lane_base + b] = l2_store_wstrb[b];
    355                                                          end
    356                                                      end
    357                                                  end
    358                                              
    359                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    360                                                  // BRAM port muxing (single-port per way)
    361                                                  // Priority: fill > store > vline_rd > lookup/line_rd
    362                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    363             1                         21         always_comb begin
    364             1                         21             bram_addr = lookup_set;
    365             1                         21             bram_din  = '0;
    366                                              
    367             1                         21             for (int w = 0; w < NO_OF_WAYS; w++) begin
    367             2                        168     
    368             1                        168                 bram_en[w]  = 1'b0;
    369             1                        168                 bram_wea[w] = '0;
    370                                                      end
    371                                              
    372                                                      if (l2_fill_en) begin
    373             1                          2                 bram_addr = l2_fill_addr[`SET_BITS];
    374             1                          2                 bram_din  = l2_fill_line;
    375             1                          2                 for (int w = 0; w < NO_OF_WAYS; w++) begin
    375             2                         16     
    376             1                         16                     bram_en[w]  = (l2_fill_way == w[2:0]);
    377             1                         16                     bram_wea[w] = (l2_fill_way == w[2:0]) ? {BRAM_WE_WIDTH{1'b1}} : '0;
    378                                                          end
    379                                                      end else if (l2_store_en && last_hit_valid) begin
    380             1                    ***0***                 bram_addr = last_hit_set;
    381             1                    ***0***                 bram_din  = store_din;
    382             1                    ***0***                 for (int w = 0; w < NO_OF_WAYS; w++) begin
    382             2                    ***0***     
    383             1                    ***0***                     bram_en[w]  = (last_hit_way == w[2:0]);
    384             1                    ***0***                     bram_wea[w] = (last_hit_way == w[2:0]) ? store_we_mask : '0;
    385                                                          end
    386                                                      end else if (vline_rd_fire) begin
    387             1                    ***0***                 bram_addr = l2_vline_rd_set;
    388             1                    ***0***                 for (int w = 0; w < NO_OF_WAYS; w++) begin
    388             2                    ***0***     
    389             1                    ***0***                     bram_en[w]  = (l2_vline_rd_way == w[2:0]);
    390             1                    ***0***                     bram_wea[w] = '0;
    391                                                          end
    392                                                      end else if (lookup_fire || line_rd_fire) begin
    393             1                          8                 bram_addr = line_rd_fire ? line_rd_set : lookup_set;
    394             1                          8                 for (int w = 0; w < NO_OF_WAYS; w++) begin
    394             2                         64     
    395             1                         64                     bram_en[w]  = 1'b1;
    396             1                         64                     bram_wea[w] = '0;
    397                                                          end
    398                                                      end
    399                                                  end
    400                                              
    401                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    402                                                  // BRAM instantiation per way (same style as L1_Dcache)
    403                                                  // IMPORTANT: Your blk_mem_gen_1 must be configured for:
    404                                                  //   - Write width: 512
    405                                                  //   - Read width : 512
    406                                                  //   - Depth      : 2048 (11-bit address)
    407                                                  //   - Byte write enable: 64 bits (one per byte)
    408                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    409                                                  genvar gw;
    410                                                  generate
    411                                                      for (gw = 0; gw < NO_OF_WAYS; gw++) begin : WAY_BRAM
    412                                                          (* dont_touch = "true" *) blk_mem_gen_1 u_bram_way2 (
    413                                                              .clka  (clk),
    414                                                              .ena   (bram_en[gw]),
    415                                                              .wea   (bram_wea[gw]),
    416                                                              .addra (bram_addr),
    417                                                              .dina  (bram_din),
    418                                                              .douta (way_data[gw])
    419                                                          );
    420                                                      end
    421                                                  endgenerate
    422                                              
    423                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    424                                                  // Metadata updates (WRITE-ONLY, no reset)
    425                                                  // FPGA power-on state ensures valid bits are 0
    426                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    427                                                  // Questa treats the initialization block above as a separate writer, so keep
    428                                                  // metadata array updates in a plain clocked always block instead of always_ff.
    429             1                          5         always @(posedge clk) begin
    430                                                      if (l2_fill_en) begin
    431             1                          2                 valid_array[l2_fill_addr[`SET_BITS]][l2_fill_way] <= 1'b1;
    432             1                          2                 tag_array[l2_fill_addr[`SET_BITS]][l2_fill_way]   <= l2_fill_addr[`TAG_BITS];
    433             1                          2                 mesi_array[l2_fill_addr[`SET_BITS]][l2_fill_way]  <= l2_fill_mesi;
    434             1                          2                 dirty_array[l2_fill_addr[`SET_BITS]][l2_fill_way] <= (l2_fill_mesi == MESI_M);
    435                                                      end
    436                                              
    437                                                      if (l2_store_en && last_hit_valid) begin
    438             1                    ***0***                 dirty_array[last_hit_set][last_hit_way] <= 1'b1;
    439                                                      end
    440                                              
    441                                                      if (l2_set_state_en) begin
    442             1                    ***0***                 mesi_array[l2_set_state_addr[`SET_BITS]][l2_set_state_way] <= l2_set_state_val;
    443                                              
    444                                                          unique case (l2_set_state_val)
    445                                                              MESI_I: begin
    446             1                    ***0***                         valid_array[l2_set_state_addr[`SET_BITS]][l2_set_state_way] <= 1'b0;
    447             1                    ***0***                         dirty_array[l2_set_state_addr[`SET_BITS]][l2_set_state_way] <= 1'b0;
    448                                                              end
    449                                                              MESI_M: begin
    450             1                    ***0***                         dirty_array[l2_set_state_addr[`SET_BITS]][l2_set_state_way] <= 1'b1;
    451                                                              end
    452                                                              MESI_S, MESI_E: begin
    453             1                    ***0***                         dirty_array[l2_set_state_addr[`SET_BITS]][l2_set_state_way] <= 1'b0;
    454                                                              end
    455                                                              default: begin
    456             1                    ***0***                         dirty_array[l2_set_state_addr[`SET_BITS]][l2_set_state_way] <= 1'b0;
    457                                                              end
    458                                                          endcase
    459                                                      end
    460                                                  end
    461                                              
    462                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    463                                                  // Hit detection (tag compare over ways)
    464                                                  // ------------------------------------------------------------
    465                                                  logic [NO_OF_WAYS-1:0] hit_vector;
    466                                                  logic                  hit_detected;
    467                                                  logic [2:0]            hit_way_detected;
    468                                              
    469             1                         20         always_comb begin
    470             1                         20             hit_vector       = '0;
    471             1                         20             hit_detected     = 1'b0;
    472             1                         20             hit_way_detected = '0;
    473                                              
    474                                                      // For line reads and normal lookup: use tag compare
    475                                                      if (op_en_r && !op_is_vline_r) begin
    476             1                          8                 for (int k = 0; k < NO_OF_WAYS; k++) begin
    476             2                         64     
    477                                                              if (valid_array[set_index_r][k] && (tag_array[set_index_r][k] == tag_r)) begin
    478             1                          6                         hit_vector[k]    = 1'b1;
    479             1                          6                         hit_detected     = 1'b1;
    480             1                          6                         hit_way_detected = k[2:0];
    481                                                              end
    482                                                          end
    483                                                      end
    484                                                  end
    485                                              
    486                                                  assign l2_hit     = hit_detected;
    487                                                  assign l2_hit_way = hit_way_detected;

    3                                                // smp_top_remade.sv
    4                                                // Dual-core RV32I + private L1I/L1D + shared snoop bus + shared L2 + AXI4-Full
    5                                                //
    6                                                // NOTE:
    7                                                // - All cache/snoop blocks in your uploaded RTL use active-low reset (rst_n).
    8                                                // - rv32i_top uses resetn_i (active-low).
    9                                                // - This top therefore exposes rst_n (active-low) for clean wiring.
    10                                               //
    11                                               // L2<->AXI adapter side ports:
    12                                               //   Uses l2_to_axi4_master's controller-side interface:
    13                                               //     mem_req_* + mem_rresp_* + mem_bresp_*
    14                                               // - L2_Cache_Controller only has mem_req_* + mem_resp_* (no IDs / split resp).
    15                                               //   We bridge by:
    16                                               //     * mem_req_id      = '0
    17                                               //     * mem_rresp_ready = 1
    18                                               //     * mem_bresp_ready = 1
    19                                               //     * L2 mem_resp_valid/line driven ONLY from mem_rresp_valid/line
    20                                               //       (do NOT OR in bresp, because L2 can issue WB then RD back-to-back).
    21                                               // ============================================================================

    343             1                          3         assign d1_ldst_valid    = c1_mem_rd | c1_mem_wr;
    344                                                  assign d1_ldst_is_store = c1_mem_wr;
    345             1                          2         assign d1_ldst_addr     = c1_mem_addr[31:0];
    346                                                  assign d1_ldst_wdata    = c1_mem_wdat;
    347             1                          3         assign d1_ldst_wstrb    = c1_mem_wr ? c1_mem_wstrb : 8'b0;
    348                                              
    349                                                  // Return full 64b to core
    350                                                  assign c0_mem_rdat = d0_ldst_rdata;
    351                                                  assign c1_mem_rdat = d1_ldst_rdata;
    352                                              
    353                                                  // Use controller response as ack (core has explicit ack)
    354                                                  assign c0_mem_ack  = d0_ldst_resp_valid;
    355                                                  assign c1_mem_ack  = d1_ldst_resp_valid;
